plans.sql:
SELECT
  "plans".tier AS "dimension_1",
  SUM(("invoice_lines".quantity * "invoice_lines".unit_price - "invoice_lines".discount_amount)) AS "metric_1"
FROM "billing"."invoice_lines" AS "invoice_lines"
LEFT JOIN "billing"."subscription_items" AS "subscription_items" ON "invoice_lines".subscription_item_id = "subscription_items".id
LEFT JOIN "billing"."plans" AS "plans" ON "subscription_items".plan_id = "plans".id
GROUP BY "plans".tier;

SELECT
  "product_families".name AS "dimension_1",
  SUM(("invoice_lines".quantity * "invoice_lines".unit_price - "invoice_lines".discount_amount)) AS "metric_1"
FROM "billing"."invoice_lines" AS "invoice_lines"
LEFT JOIN "billing"."subscription_items" AS "subscription_items" ON "invoice_lines".subscription_item_id = "subscription_items".id
LEFT JOIN "billing"."plans" AS "plans" ON "subscription_items".plan_id = "plans".id
LEFT JOIN "billing"."products" AS "products" ON "plans".product_id = "products".id
LEFT JOIN "billing"."product_families" AS "product_families" ON "products".family_id = "product_families".id
GROUP BY "product_families".name;

SELECT
  "currencies".code AS "dimension_1",
  SUM(("invoice_lines".quantity * "invoice_lines".unit_price - "invoice_lines".discount_amount)) AS "metric_1"
FROM "billing"."invoice_lines" AS "invoice_lines"
LEFT JOIN "billing"."invoices" AS "invoices" ON "invoice_lines".invoice_id = "invoices".id
LEFT JOIN "billing"."currencies" AS "currencies" ON "invoices".currency_id = "currencies".id
GROUP BY "currencies".code;
